programmes.title: Active year bonus 2025
programmes.description: A bonus for members who stayed active through 2025 and went to their yearly check-up, claimed once the year is over. The member joins in the patient portal or in the Klarbefund app. The hub works out inside the member's record whether the year's goal was met; AlphaKasse receives the programme, the year and goal met yes or no. Steps, heart rate, diagnoses and visit details never leave the record. A no changes nothing in the member's contract.
programmes.ruleDescription: Goal met when, in the calendar year, the member was active for at least 150 minutes a week on average and went to one check-up. Read from the exercise minutes the member's tracker shares into the record (LOINC 55411-3, a week without any counts as none) and from the check-up in the member's own EHR (SNOMED CT 185349003). Evaluated by the hub inside the record once the year has ended; the member sees the result before anything is sent.

legalBasis: Primary use the person directs, EHDS Art. 2(2)(d) and 7(3); explicit consent, GDPR Art. 9(2)(a) (ADR-080)
